criteria: The chosen service must belong to the integration context supplied in the literal prompt, with actual source evidence for accepted arguments and processing states.
The frontend frame must be derived from delivered source; unrelated billing, generic workflow or marketing services do not satisfy this scope.
Record first query and ranked hits, locator dependencies, delivered bodies, native model responses, complete usage and all failed attempts.
Do not grade metadata, outline or declined calls as a delivered body. Missing facts must remain explicit.
limits: Diagnostic current-main reproduction, not a new full benchmark or proof of a policy fix. No answer paths or gold are injected.
